about: A generated pack whose renderers each return one element or line, so the cost is the SDK's and the runtime's: assembling a runtime (which builds the composition schema), validating, and rendering. Each axis moves alone from 10 primitive types, 100 flat nodes and 800 label characters. Every composition uses one of the pack's types, so the primitive axis changes only the pack. Assembling excludes defining the pack, which a host has already done. Each surface's `render` validates first, so the render columns include a validate. Times past the first validate are the median of repeated calls in the same process.
